title: What Is Man? God's Majesty and Human Dignity
summary: Framed by the refrain “O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth”, this hymn praises God whose glory fills the heavens and who silences his enemies through the praise of children. Looking up at the moon and stars, David marvels that God cares for human beings at all, and then marvels again that God has crowned them with glory and set them over his works.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: Songs of praise, or hymns, praise God for who he is and what he has made (Psalms 8, 100, 104).

line: Praise for the LORD whose name is majestic in all the earth, and wonder that the maker of moon and stars cares for human beings and crowns them with glory.
guide: Go outside on a clear night and ask the psalm's question about yourself. Let both answers settle: you are small, and you are crowned. Then ask how you are caring for the people, creatures and land put into your hands, since a crown given by God is a trust.

stanzas.title: Heading and refrain: how majestic is your name
Praise from infants silences God's enemies
Under the night sky: what is man?
Crowned with glory and set over God's works

verses.t: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
